description:

Without `niche`: a compact list of keys. With `niche`: that trade in full — its tags, coverage and the conditions its businesses publish.
A `niche` that is not a key comes back with `variants` and why (a tag, a similar name, a meaning) — nothing is substituted: pick a key.
`detail: "full"` lists every trade in full.

detail.description: compact (default without a matched niche): keys and counts; full: every niche with tags, coverage and conditions

location.description: a 5-digit US postcode, a city ("Tampa, FL") or "lat,lng". Optional: without it every niche is listed with its totals.

niche.description: one niche key: that niche in full (tags, coverage, every condition it publishes). Another word returns `variants` with why, never a substitute

radius_miles.description: How far from the location counts as «here». Default 15 (the same in every tool).
